## Context

Executable repository work for the user-authorized consolidation. The integration branch already preserves substantive worktree histories and unrelated local state; this Issue governs exact-commit QA, PR, merge, release and production verification.

## Expected outcome

The consolidated symphony revision reaches main and its canonical production runtime with exact-revision evidence.

## Scope

- Candidate verification
- Pull request and merge
- Release and production verification

## Out of scope

- Deleting worktrees
- Unrelated fixes except release-blocking integration defects

## Acceptance criteria

- Candidate branch is clean except explicitly preserved ignored/local dependency links.
- Complete available QA passes on the exact commit.
- Governed pull request merges without force.
- Immutable release deploys once and exact production flow passes.
